from scipy.optimize import least_squares
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
V=np.var(sigma)
def run(name,f,n=10,trials=25):
    bb=None
    for _ in range(trials):
        p0=rng.normal(size=n)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p,eps,T)-sigma, p0, max_nfev=500)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (bb is None or r.cost<bb.cost): bb=r
        except Exception:
            pass
    if bb is None: print(name,'fail'); return
    print(name, 2*bb.cost/len(sigma)/V, np.round(bb.x,3))
